notes.title: Patch Update for August 14 - Fate Trigger CBT
notes.content:
Dear Awakeners,



We are planning to deploy a patch update for the Fate Trigger Closed Beta Test on Thursday, August 14th, at 4:00 PM EDT. This update will be applied without server downtime. However, you will need to restart your game client to download the patch before you can log back in.



▼ Update Details:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/5622ea8b9f6a98da3dbaf873b7fa074a3cad9c40.png"]

Weekend Training: Bonus Rewards Are Here!

Play the Rapid Trials mode during the event to get Rank Protection Cards * 2. Squad up and rank up with confidence!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/011cee15655413d04ecf2527d46cd9a60eb4e496.png"]

 Fixed several issues that could cause crashes or stuttering in some cases.

Fixed a bug causing the in-game FPS counter to display incorrectly.

 Fixed an issue in Awakener Trials that sometimes prevented Cynric from using ziplines.

[hr][/hr]
Please remember that this CBT build does not represent the final version of the game. If you encounter any issues, please join our official Discord server 

https://discord.gg/fatetrigger

 to submit bug reports and feedback. Our team will follow up and address them promptly. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

Fate Trigger Dev Team

notes.title: Patch Update for July 31 - Fate Trigger CBT
notes.content:
Dear Awakeners,



We are planning to deploy a patch update for the Fate Trigger Closed Beta Test on Thursday, July 31st, at 4:00 PM EDT.

This update will be applied without server downtime. However, you will need to restart your game client to download the patch before you can log back in.


New Game Mode Arrival

>Team Deathmatch (FPP) - CBT Demo
Time-Limited Mode, available for: Every Saturday and Sunday during the CBT from 12:00 PM (Noon) to 12:00 AM (Midnight) \[Depending on your server].

Mode Details: Squad up, pick your equipment, and rack up eliminations in this FPP! Victory goes to the first team to hit the score limit or the team with the most points when time's up!

*Note: This is CBT demo which does not represent the final result. Feedback & suggestions are appreciated and will be carefully reviewed.

>Rapid Trials
Time-Limited Mode, available for: Every Saturday and Sunday during the CBT from 12:00 PM (Noon) to 12:00 AM (Midnight) \[Depending on your server].

Mode Details: The Rapid Trial mode features a small-scale shrinking circle mechanism, offering a faster-paced combat experience. Awakeners can directly pick up and equip various weapon chips, while armor, compared to the Awakener Trial mode, comes with additional damage reduction. The TTK in this mode is also extended. Additionally, by accumulating damage to the enemies, your armor can evolve to higher levels! With rapid shrinking circles, intense fights, and strategic use of items, come challenge your in-game limits to crown the victory!


Update Details:

Balance Adjustments

> Awakener Adjustments
Eos (Luminary):

Diffraction (Ultimate): Duration increased from 20s to 25s. Now, downing an enemy extends the duration by 5s (up to a maximum of 25s).

Xiva (Firestorm):

Searing Munitions (Passive), Azure Divide (Tactical), & Corvite Storm (Ultimate): All abilities now apply an additional 25% slow effect that lasts for 2 seconds upon dealing damage.

Soarwynne (Windranger):

Skyward Leap (Tactical): Can now use weapons and items after the initial jump. The leap range has been adjusted from 13m ~ 35m to 7m ~ 35m.

Dev Note: "Soarwynne is currently underperforming compared to other Assault Awakeners. We want Skyward Leap to create more opportunities for high-impact plays. By increasing her options for jump height and allowing her to act during the leap, we hope to make her more dynamic."


> Weapon Adjustments
Gladiator Assault Rifle: Damage reduced (Upper Body: 35 → 33, Lower Body: 27 → 25). Increased long-range damage falloff.Slightly increased recoil.

Dev Note: "Our goal for the Gladiator AR is for it to be a high-skill weapon that rewards practice. Currently, its ease of use is too similar to the entry-level CL-4 AR, and its high damage is crowding out other weapons. These adjustments are intended to better define its role."


Bug Fixes


> Fixed several issues that could cause crashes, stuttering, or frame drops.

> Fixed a UI display issue when DLSS Frame Generation was enabled.

> Fixed UI display issues that could occur after setting custom keybinds.

> Fixed an issue that could cause interaction problems after setting custom keybinds.

> Fixed a bug with deadzone settings for PlayStation controllers.

> Fixed various general controller interaction bugs.

> Fixed an issue causing some missions to not track progress correctly.

> Fixed an issue preventing recruitment/squad information from being deleted.

> Fixed a bug with custom color settings for squad banners.

> Fixed several issues with the voice chat function.

> Fixed a bug causing player stats to display incorrectly.

> Fixed display issues with some Charms.

> Fixed an issue causing muzzle flash effects to display incorrectly.

>  Fixed a bug where players could be repeatedly teleported while inside an updraft area.

> Fixed an issue in some areas that could cause players to get stuck in a floating state.

> Fixed a bug where the backpack UI would display incorrectly after reconnecting to a match.

> Fixed an issue preventing ziplines from being used correctly.

> Fixed a bug that sometimes caused Eos's Tactical ability to fail on activation.

> Fixed an issue that allowed Ryoin to use his long-range leap while on a zipline.

> Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented players from picking up equipment in the Training Grounds.


[hr][/hr]
Please remember that this CBT build does not represent the final version of the game. If you encounter any issues, please 

join our official Discord server https://discord.gg/fatetrigger

 to submit bug reports and feedback. Our team will follow up and address them promptly. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience.

Thank you for your understanding and support!




Fate Trigger Dev Team

notes.title: How to Join the Fate Trigger Closed Beta Test
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/e29dfc8dd9f332bf777ca407769795162f172766.jpg"]
You can get access to the Closed Beta Test (CBT) through the following methods. There are two ways to get into the game: via Steam or our Official Website Launcher. Please double-check which platform each sign-up method is for.

Request Access on Steam

Visit the official Fate Trigger store page and click the "Request Access" button. This will enter you into a pool for a chance to be selected to play on Steam. (Note: Access is not guaranteed due to limited slots).[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3092530/_/"][/dynamiclink]

Participate in Discord Events

Join our official Discord server and take part in special giveaways and community events. Winners will receive a Beta Key for our Official Website Launcher.

Earn Access via Twitch Drops

Link your game account and watch partnered Fate Trigger streams during our official campaigns. By watching 60 minutes, you can earn a Beta Key that can be redeemed on Steam or the Official website.

Receive an In-Game Friend Referral

Players already in the CBT can earn a shareable Beta Key by completing special in-game challenges. Your friend must then go to the official website to download the game launcher. After installing and running the launcher, they will be prompted to enter the Beta Key to activate their access.

All Closed Alpha players will gain access to the Closed Beta Test

If you have participated in our last Closed Alpha test on Steam, you are all set! You will automatically receive access to the CBT directly in your Steam library. No further action is needed.



We look forward to seeing you in the game! To discuss the test and get the latest news, be sure to join our official community.





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193118/1110d98a7010c2238d53657229e74b8bcc3bbfa9.png"]

notes.title: Closed Alpha Begins on Sep 25th!
notes.content:
Feeling confused about how to join Fate Trigger: The Novita Closed Alpha? Check the frequently asked questions and answers below!

1. What should I know about the Closed Alpha?
The Closed Alpha will be held on Steam from September 25th, 2024, at 7:00 AM (EDT) to September 30th, 2024 at 11:59 AM (EDT). After the test is over, the server will be closed, and all account information will be erased. 

2. How do I get access to the Closed Alpha?
Visit https://bit.ly/fttnsteam, and click "Request Access" under "Join Fate Trigger: The Novita Playtest" to sign up.
We will grant a limited number of playtest access slots daily at 12 PM EDT. (Be sure to check both the Steam store page and your email for updates on your access status!)

3. What's the Recommended System Requirement?
Recommended Specs:
64-bit processor and operating system
OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K/AMD Ryzen 9 5900X
Memory: 16GB*2 RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 3060 Ti 8GB
DirectX: Version 12
Network: Broadband Internet connection
Storage: 30 GB available space (Recommend installation on SSD for optimal performance)

Minimum Specs:
64-bit processor and operating system
OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K/AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
Memory: 16 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti 6GB
DirectX: Version 12
Network: Broadband Internet connection
Storage: 30 GB available space (Recommend installation on SSD for optimal performance)
*Please note that:
1. Unfortunately, AMD graphics cards are not supported in this test as we haven’t finished the compatibility development for the AMD series.
2. Likewise, laptops currently need higher specs to run the game, so we suggest playing on a PC whenever possible.

4. What if I have more questions or need help?
Join our Discord community to get the latest updates and connect with us directly for answers. https://discord.gg/fatetrigger
